name: lqt-surface-deep-transfer-mcp
description: Create and review Surface Deep and Transfer learning experiences aligned to educator-supplied targets, with evidence-led phase progression.

interface.longDescription: Build classroom-ready Surface, Deep and Transfer activities, questions, combined options or assessment tasks. Ask grade, learning target and output preference one at a time. Preserve original phase-specific evidence checks, grade-friendly language, supports, extensions and novel-context transfer.
capabilities: Design Surface, Deep, and Transfer learning experiences
Create activities, questions or assessment tasks
Review evidence-driven progression and authentic transfer
defaultPrompt: Help me create Surface, Deep & Transfer learning opportunities.

positive.prompt: Use get_surface_deep_transfer_framework with grade 7, target I can classify organisms based on shared characteristics, product Both.
positive.expected_behavior: Surface, Deep and Transfer each have two activities and 6-8 questions plus all evidence fields and novel transfer.

positive.prompt: Use get_surface_deep_transfer_framework with Grade 2, target I can explain how sunlight and water help plants grow, product Activities.
positive.expected_behavior: Two age-suitable activities for each phase, appropriate foundation and genuinely new transfer contexts.

positive.prompt: Use get_surface_deep_transfer_framework with High School Lit Comp II, target I can evaluate arguments using relevant evidence, product Assessment Task.
positive.expected_behavior: Phase checkpoints, reasoned task, novel-context performance task, and four-level scoring guide.

positive.prompt: Use get_surface_deep_transfer_framework with Adult GED, target I can compare evidence from two sources, product Questions.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept unrestricted grade and supply 8-10 appropriate questions per phase with novel transfer.

positive.prompt: Use review_surface_deep_transfer with grade 7, target I can classify organisms, product Both, draft: Surface memorize categories; Deep list categories again; Transfer list categories a third time.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify missing deep reasoning and novelty, plus phase evidence gaps and actionable corrections.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in London?
Help me design Surface, Deep and Transfer activities.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask only the freely typed grade first.

negative.prompt: Grade 6; target I can explain energy flow in a food web.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask only for Activities, Questions, Both, or Assessment Task; do not generate yet.

publication.release_notes: Review-ready version with demonstration video; preserves Surface, Deep, Transfer progressions, four modes, evidence checks, unrestricted grades and original resources.
